content: Lilobhe kwa bhando bha ku Chalide

“Jhandika yenio ntumiche jwa kunane kwa Chapanga kwa lilongo lya bhando lilinnyeketii Kilichitu lya ku Chalide.” “Lilobhe lende lihuma kwa jwajho jwakamwii ihuke chaba ya Chapanga na ndondwa chaba. Niimanye itendwa hino na manye umanyikana kubhehe ghome kumbe nhwile!
Nnyimuke, kangamalicha ilebhe iighilile kwino kabula na chenie kinawejhe. Nhwalo ade ngohe, ninaibhona jhe itendwa hino ipoghombile palonge jha Chapanga gwango.
Nkomboka, ghumolitwe na ghinyohine, maghachokolekeya gheniya na muuleke uhakaho. Nambo nakubhehejhe miho, niika kwa kupwitikilila pwitu ngita mwihe naumanye jhe lichaa limbakuhika.
Nambo bhabhii bhando bhandina kwenio ku Chalide bhangahakaa ngobho yabhe. Bheniya nabhatyanga na nenga, kongo bhawalite ngobho nhuo ya mbuu nhwalo bheniya bhitopela.

Jwapakuhotola nawalichwa ngobho nhuo ya mbuu. Nenga nambuta ng'o liina lyabhe mukitabo cha ughome, kabhele naninobholela Tate gwango na palonge jha akatumiche bhake bha kunane kwa Chapanga bhamba ndi bhango.
“Jwabhii na machikilo, abangatuka Uhuke alilobholela lilongo lya bhando lilinnyeketii Kilichitu!”
Lilobhe kwa bhando bha ku Filadefiya

“Jhandika yenio ntumiche jwa kunane kwa Chapanga kwa lilongo lya bhando lilinnyeketii Kilichitu lya ku Filadefiya.” “Lilobhe lende ndi lihumii palonge jwabhii nyahinyahi na jhuna uchakaka, jhuna pungulo jha Daude. Pajhoghola nnyango abhii jhe mundo jwahoto kujhighala, na pajhighala nnyango abhii jhe mundo jwahoto kujhoghola.

Chakaka nighamanye ghimihenga ghoha! Ngohe nnyogwile nnyango nnonge jhino abhii jhe mundo jwahoto kudinda, manye kubhehe nkwete makakala ghandina, nambo milijhohine lilobhe lyango na milikanitejhe liina lyango.

Jhokanikiya! Naninetela bhando bha lilongo lya nyumba jhiijhinamila Limbembela bhibhakikema Akayahude, kone Akayahude jhe, nambo akawange. Nanaleta kwino na kwatenda bhatame makilikite palonge jhino na bhando bhoha bhamanye kubhehe nenga ndehi kumpala.
Nhwalo mwenga muchokolikii nhilo gwango gwa kuhimbilila, nenga naninonda kipinde cha malola chikiika pannema ghoha, kwajhigha bhando bhoha bhibhatama pannema.
Nihika kwino kajhombe! Nkamula pyee chinkwete, ili mundo jhojhoha angampoka jhe hupo jhino.

Jwapakuhotola nanimmeka abhe luheke mu Nyumba jha Chapanga gwango. Napitijhe ng'o mwono. Chakaka, kabhele nanyandika panane jhake liina lya Chapanga gwango na liina lya muche gwa Chapanga gwango, yane Yeluchalemo nhyono, muche gwenio nahuluka kuhumii kunane kwa Chapanga gwango. Na helahela panane jhake jwenio jwahotola nanyandika liina lyango lihyono.
“Jwabhii na machikilo, abangatuka Uhuke alilobholela lilongo lya bhando lilinnyeketii Kilichitu!”
Lilobhe kwa bhando bhu ku Laodikiya

“Jhandika yenio ntumiche kwa lilongo lya bhando bhibhannyeketii Kilichitu bhu ku Laodikiya.” “Nenga nikemwa Amina, jwayekula uchakaka ghuhobholeka, jwenio ndi lihembuko lya ilebhe yoha yaipangine Chapanga.
Nighamanye ghimihenga ghoha! Manye kubhehe mwe mahihimojhe hilu mapyojhe. Mbaha makabhii mahihimo anda jhe mapyoo!
Bhahe, nhwalo mwenga mapyoo, amu mahihimojhe, nanintapika!
Mwe mikolekela, ‘Mina ilebhe mbwe, na mmii na kila kilebhe mipalajhe kilebhe chochoha.’ Nambo mwenga umanyijhe maleghelaho, ipalwa nkolelwe kiya, mwe mahocho mangalola na mmi matako matopo!

Na nenga ninaghalikiya nhemele kwango chaabo jhikehitwe pa mwotu kupala mme na kila ki lebhe chakaka. Chakaka, mbaha nhemele ngobho nhuu jha mbuu kupala nhibhilikiya hone jhino jhukutama matako matopo. Na hele nhemela ntela mpakala miho ghino kupala nnole.
Nenga kunkelebhuya na ninnakalila jhojhoha jhunimpala. Yene nghaghe na ghalambuka kuuleka uhakaho.
Jhokanikiya! Nenga nijhema pa nnyango na kukong'onda nnyango. Mundo jhojhoha anda ajhohine lilobhe lyango na kujhogho nnyango, nanyingila nakulye nako, na jwenio nalya pamonga na nenga.
Jwapakuhotola nanimmeka atame pamonga na nenga pa kighoda cha unahota nkolongwa ngita nenga chinhotwile kutama pamonga na Tate gwango pa kigoda cha unahota nkolongwa.
“Jwabhii na machikilo, abangatuka Uhuke aghalobholela malongo gha bhando ghighannyeketii Kilichitu!”
